title: whk 1.20.0, SDK 1.30.0, MCP 2.4.0, Python and Go 0.10.0
items: The changelog lists whk 1.20.0, SDK 1.30.0, MCP 2.4.0 and the Python and Go SDKs 0.10.0: billing changes an agent asks for and the owner approves, the agent spend budget, checkout links for the person to pay, whk setup agent, and the CLI's alerts, previews, send-email, downloads and server-side replay
